title: Every public review_queues function needs a Databricks guard entry and a matching test case
answers: add new review queue function on databricks
which review_queues functions are guarded against databricks
test databricks guardrail for review queue API
new review queue API missing databricks_api_disabled
body:
Invariant: each public function in mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py carries @databricks_api_disabled whose first argument is the function's exact __name__, because the guard error message embeds that name.
Enforced by: tests/genai/review_queues/test_review_queues_sdk.py:test_databricks_tracking_uri_rejected, a parametrized list of (fn, args, kwargs) covering all 10 public functions on both "databricks" and "databricks://profile" URIs. It asserts INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE, the function name, the "Use the workspace Reviews UI." guidance, and that TracingClient.__init__ is not called.
What breaks if skipped: an unguarded function reaches the OSS /api/3.0/mlflow/review-queues routes on Databricks and returns the misleading INTERNAL_ERROR Not Found; a mismatched name string makes the test's match pattern fail.
Constraints: when adding a new public review_queues function, add it to that parametrized list as well, using the same guard message string constant _REVIEWS_UI_ALTERNATIVE.
applies: Adding or renaming public functions in mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py and their SDK tests.
says: Calling review queue commands against managed workspaces returns a misleading internal error.
Direct cloud workspace users to the reviews interface instead of failing review queue operations.
Review queue operations fail with an unexplained not found error on hosted workspaces.
Guide workspace accounts to use the review interface for human feedback queues.
search: Every public function in mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py must carry @databricks_api_disabled with the function's exact __name__ as its first argument. Without this guard, calls on databricks or databricks://profile URIs reach unhandled OSS routes and fail with misleading INTERNAL_ERROR Not Found rather than directing users to the workspace Reviews UI via _REVIEWS_UI_ALTERNATIVE. New or renamed functions must be added to the parametrized list in tests/genai/review_queues/test_review_queues_sdk.py:test_databricks_tracking_uri_rejected asserting INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE, the function name, and that TracingClient.__init__ is not called.
